prompt:
Create a polished, high-fidelity conventional mobile coffee-roastery landing page for the fictional Minsk brand «Кварта». Render the webpage edge to edge as a 390 CSS-pixel-wide mobile viewport at retina resolution on a 9:16 portrait canvas, with crisp readable Russian text, no browser window and no device frame. Show the first viewport and the beginning of the next section.

This comparison baseline intentionally uses familiar coffee-site conventions: warm neutral surfaces, dark brown typography, careful product photography and a straightforward vertical single-column flow. Use a compact wordmark and menu header. Keep the hero compact so the complete single-column callback form and the catalog's beginning appear. Show generic kraft coffee packaging with a plain «Кварта» label and no additional descriptive claims. Keep photography secondary to the offer and form.

The visitor wants fresh beans at home and requests a callback; there is no cart or payment. Exact hero text: «Кварта», «Свежая обжарка. Кофе домой.», «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим», «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка · 54 BYN / месяц». The subscription includes two 250 g packs monthly and delivery.

The single-column form has persistent visible labels «Имя», «Телефон», «Интерес» with choices «Разовый заказ», «Подписка», «Вопрос», and «Комментарий (необязательно)». Its primary button reads «Оставить заявку» with «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором». Keep every field full-width, comfortably spaced and usable on a narrow phone.

The compact header menu contains «Кофе», «Подписка», «Доставка». Begin the next section «Что обжариваем» with only «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN»; optional supplied tasting text is «Цветочный, бергамот». Use only these supplied origin facts, with no other tasting notes, claims, badges, testimonials, discounts or contact details.
